The Egypt international suffered a minor muscle injury in last weekend's match against Crystal Palace and was given a standing ovation by fans.  **Salah**, who will leave Anfield at the end of the campaign, has scored 257 goals for Liverpool since his arrival in 2017. He is expected to play for **Liverpool** in their remaining games before potentially joining another club.

recent_articles.title: Lindsey Vonn still in 'survival mode' after Olympic crash and unsure whether to retire - BBC Sport
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lindsey Vonn** is uncertain about her future in skiing following a serious crash at the 2026 Winter Olympics. The American, who has had eight surgeries since breaking her leg and ankle, says she may retire or never race again. She is currently focused on recovering from her injuries and will undergo one more surgery to repair her ACL before a lengthy rehabilitation period. **Vonn**, who won two world titles in 2009, expressed that she wants to assess her life situation before making any decisions about her future in skiing.

recent_articles.title: ‘Don’t fall!’: foil boarders describe hair-raising shark chase caught on video off California coast | California | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ron Takeda** and **Tavis Boise**, two surfers, were chased for five minutes by a large shark off the coast of Santa Barbara. The encounter, captured on video, has gone viral.  Experts at the **National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration** confirmed that the creature was likely a great white shark. While initially panicked, Takeda and Boise concluded the shark's behavior was likely curiosity rather than aggression. They plan to return to the water next week.

recent_articles.title: Arsenal vs Fulham: Premier League – teams, start, lineups, title race | Football News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arsenal** will aim to re-establish a six-point lead over **Manchester City** in the Premier League title race when they host **Fulham** at the Emirates Stadium on Saturday.  The Gunners, who were overtaken by **City** after their 2-1 victory last month, are seeking to secure their first English crown since 2004. **Fulham**, currently in 10th place, will be looking to capitalize on any potential Arsenal fatigue following their Champions League semi-final loss to **Atletico Madrid**.  The match is the 67th between the two sides, with **Arsenal** holding a significant advantage.
